positions.as_written: Repeat with the knee in a different flexion angle if the tenderness is posterior, since deeper flexion brings the posterior horns more accessible.
Record the location precisely, because anterior, mid and posterior joint line tenderness mean different things.
In medicolegal work tenderness is a reported symptom rather than an observed sign, and that limit should be stated when an opinion rests on it.
